mapper.select: SELECT * FROM players WHERE line_user_id = #{lineUserId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO players ( line_user_id, group_id, current_stage, player_name, start_at, finished_at, current_riddle_id, last_active ) VALUES ( #{lineUserId}, #{groupId}, #{currentStage}, #{playerName}, #{startAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{currentRiddleId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE players SET current_stage = #{currentStage}, last_active = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE players SET line_user_id = #{lineUserId},group_id = #{groupId}, current_stage = #{currentStage},last_active = #{lastActive} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE players SET current_riddle_id = #{nextRiddleId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE players SET finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM players WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND finished_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_at, finished_at) ASC
